# Renesas Electronics Corporation

> Renesas is a leading semiconductor manufacturer specializing in microcontrollers, analog ICs, power management, and automotive solutions for embedded systems and IoT applications.

Renesas Electronics Corporation provides a comprehensive portfolio of semiconductor products including MCUs, FPGAs, analog ICs, power discretes, and automotive-grade solutions. The company serves industrial automation, IoT, automotive, and embedded processing markets globally with design tools and development support.

## Key Topics

- Microcontroller (MCU)
- Arm Cortex-M
- Automotive Solutions
- Power Management
- MOSFET/GaN FET
- Analog ICs
- FPGA
- IoT/Edge Computing
- Embedded Systems
- Battery Management
- Industrial Automation
- DC/DC Converters
- USB/Interface
- Timing/Clocks
- ASIC/IP Design

## Core Product Portfolio

- [Microcontrollers & Microprocessors (MCUs, MPUs)](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/microcontrollers-microprocessors): MCU/MPU portfolio including RA, RZ, RL78, RX, RISC-V and RH850 series for embedded processing.
- [Automotive Products](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/automotive-products): Automotive MCUs, power management, sensors for ADAS, EVs and in-vehicle systems.
- [Power Management](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/power-management): Power management ICs: FET drivers, DC-DC converters, battery management solutions.
- [Power Discretes](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/power-discretes): Power discrete portfolio: MOSFETs and GaN FETs for industrial and automotive applications.
- [Analog Products](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/analog-products): Analog IC portfolio: operational amplifiers, data converters, audio/video solutions.

## Specialized Semiconductors

- [Memory & Logic](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/memory-logic): Memory and logic products: SRAM, MRAM, RCD, data buffers and bus switch ICs.
- [Clocks & Timing](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/clocks-timing): Timing ICs: oscillators, clock generators, PCIe and data center timing solutions.
- [Interface](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/interface): Interface ICs and wired connectivity solutions for industrial and embedded systems.
- [ASIC & IP](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/asic-ip): Custom ASIC and IP solutions including CPU cores, memory and interface IPs.

## Global Presence & Support

- [Renesas Electronics Corporation (English)](https://www.renesas.com/en): Renesas global homepage showcasing MCUs, FPGAs, MOSFETs and embedded design solutions.
- [Renesas Electronics Corporation (日本語)](https://www.renesas.com/ja): Renesas Japanese homepage featuring microcontrollers, SoCs and automotive solutions.
- [Renesas Electronics Corporation (中文)](https://www.renesas.com/zh): Renesas Chinese homepage with MCUs, FPGAs, MOSFETs and semiconductor products.
- [Sample Request](https://www.renesas.com/en/sample-request): Product sample ordering and request portal with MyRenesas account integration.
